Class WriteOptions

java.lang.Object
org.apache.opendal.WriteOptions
public class WriteOptions extends Object
Options for write operations.

All supplied conditions must hold for the write to commit. Unsupported conditions, append, or expires fail with OpenDALException.Code.Unsupported. Unsupported metadata options may be ignored. Failed conditions fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch. Invalid expires or ifNotChanged values fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid. Presigned write requests validate options and capabilities without executing against storage.

Optional reference fields default to null.

    • ifMatch

      public final String ifMatch
      Write only when the file at the write path has this exact ETag.

      The condition succeeds when the file exists and its ETag equals this value. A file with a different ETag, or a missing file, fails the write with OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch. Only concrete ETag values are portable; a wildcard such as "*" has no portable meaning here.

      See Also:
      • Capability.writeWithIfMatch

    • ifNoneMatch

      public final String ifNoneMatch
      Write only when the file at the write path does not have this ETag.

      With a concrete ETag value, the condition succeeds when the file has a different ETag or does not exist; the write then replaces or creates the file. A file whose ETag equals this value fails the write with OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch. Only concrete ETag values are portable; a wildcard such as "*" has no portable meaning here.

      See Also:
      • Capability.writeWithIfNoneMatch

    • ifNotExists

      public final boolean ifNotExists
      Write only when no file exists at the write path.

      The condition succeeds when the path is empty, so the write creates the file. An existing file fails the write with OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch.

      See Also:
      • Capability.writeWithIfNotExists

    • concurrent

      public final int concurrent
      Sets concurrent write operations for this writer.

      Defaults to 1. Values less than or equal to 0, or too large for the native platform's unsigned pointer-sized integer, fail with OpenDALException.Code.Unexpected.

      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • chunk

      public final long chunk
      Sets chunk size for buffered writes.

      The default of -1L uses the service's default chunk size. Positive values set the chunk size in bytes and must fit the native platform's unsigned pointer-sized integer. 0L, other negative values, and values that do not fit fail with OpenDALException.Code.Unexpected.

      See Also:
      • Capability.writeMultiMinSize
      • Capability.writeMultiMaxSize
      • Constant Field Values

    • contentLanguage

      public final String contentLanguage
      Sets Content-Language system metadata on the object being written.

      Use a language tag or a comma-separated list of tags, such as fr-CA, en. Check Capability.writeWithContentLanguage for support. A subsequent stat can retrieve the stored value with Metadata.contentLanguage. Services without support may ignore this option.

      See Also:
      • Capability.writeWithContentLanguage

    • expires

      public final Duration expires
      Sets how long the new file lives after the write commits.

      A supplied duration overrides the service's default TTL. When unset, the service uses its usual expiration policy. Services round positive durations up to their supported precision.

      Supply a positive Duration. Zero, negative, or unrepresentable durations fail with OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid. The write fails with OpenDALException.Code.Unsupported when the service does not advertise Capability.writeWithExpires.

      See Also:
      • Capability.writeWithExpires

    • ifVersionMatch

      public final String ifVersionMatch
      Write only when the file at the write path has this exact version.

      The condition succeeds when the file exists and its version equals this value. A file with a different version, or a missing file, fails the write with OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch.

      See Also:
      • Capability.writeWithIfVersionMatch

    • ifVersionNotMatch

      public final String ifVersionNotMatch
      Write only when the file at the write path does not have this version.

      The condition succeeds when the file exists with a different version. A file whose version equals this value fails the write with OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch. When no file exists at the write path, no portable behavior is defined.

      See Also:
      • Capability.writeWithIfVersionNotMatch

    • ifNotChanged

      public final Metadata ifNotChanged
      Write only when the file at the write path still has the identity recorded in this metadata.

      Pass metadata previously returned by OpenDAL for the same path. OpenDAL derives a version match when the service supports version conditions and the metadata contains a version. Otherwise it uses a non-weak ETag if present. A changed or missing file fails the write with OpenDALException.Code.ConditionNotMatch, as does combining this option with a conflicting ifMatch or ifVersionMatch value.

      The operation returns OpenDALException.Code.Unsupported when the service does not support the derived primitive condition, and OpenDALException.Code.ConfigInvalid when the metadata contains neither a version nor a non-weak ETag.
